remarks: Enjoy open-concept living in this beautifully updated one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo located in a sought-after gated community. The living room boasts cathedral ceilings with a skylight, creating a bright and airy space. The recently renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Newer stainless steel washer & dryer. The primary bedroom offers two double-door closets and direct access to a private balcony. The recently renovated bathroom includes a skylight, adding natural light to the modern design. New air-conditioning condenser. Enjoy the community's two outdoor pools. 24 hour security.
